steps.message: Open the dialer app. Clear any pop-ups that may appear by granting all permissions that are required.

Execute: adb shell 's1=$(settings get secure dialer_default_application); s2=$(cmd role holders android.app.role.DIALER 2>/dev/null | tr -d "[]," | awk "{print \$1}" ); s3=$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.DIAL 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | cut -d/ -f1); pkg=$s1; [ -z "$pkg" ] || [ "$pkg" = "null" ] && pkg=$s2; [ -z "$pkg" ] || [ "$pkg" = "null" ] && pkg=$s3; echo "PKG=$pkg"; am start -a android.intent.action.DIAL'

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell 's1=$(settings get secure dialer_default_application); s2=$(cmd role holders android.app.role.DIALER 2>/dev/null | tr -d "[]," | awk "{print \$1}" ); s3=$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.DIAL 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | cut -d/ -f1); pkg=$s1; [ -z "$pkg" ] || [ "$pkg" = "null" ] && pkg=$s2; [ -z "$pkg" ] || [ "$pkg" = "null" ] && pkg=$s3; echo "PKG=$pkg"; am start -a android.intent.action.DIAL'"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell 'pkg=$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.DIAL 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | cut -d/ -f1); echo PKG=$pkg; am start -a android.intent.action.DIAL >/dev/null 2>&1; for p in android.permission.READ_CONTACTS android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO; do pm grant "$pkg" "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; for p in android.permission.READ_CONTACTS android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO; do printf "%s=" "$p"; pm check-permission "$pkg" "$p"; done'

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell 'pkg=$(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.DIAL 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | cut -d/ -f1); echo PKG=$pkg; am start -a android.intent.action.DIAL >/dev/null 2>&1; for p in android.permission.READ_CONTACTS android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO; do pm grant "$pkg" "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; for p in android.permission.READ_CONTACTS android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO; do printf "%s=" "$p"; pm check-permission "$pkg" "$p"; done'"

results.content:
PKG=com.google.android.dialer
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS=Unknown command: check-permission
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS=Unknown command: check-permission
android.permission.CALL_PHONE=Unknown command: check-permission
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE=Unknown command: check-permission
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG=Unknown command: check-permission
android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG=Unknown command: check-permission
android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS=Unknown command: check-permission
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO=Unknown command: check-permission

extra.finish_description: Opened the Dialer app (com.google.android.dialer) and granted all commonly required runtime permissions to prevent permission pop-ups.
